analysis: The code snippet contains two calls to the `next()` method on an `Iterator` object (`timerIt`). Both calls are inside while loops that first check `timerIt.hasNext()`. After that loop, a `System.gc()` call is made, and then a new iterator is obtained again from `outstandingTimers.iterator()` for the second loop. In both cases, the `next()` call is only made when `hasNext()` returns true, which ensures that the iterator has at least one more element. There is no concurrent modification or other thread interference visible in the snippet. Therefore, the condition for `NoSuchElementException` (iteration has no more elements) is avoided by the `hasNext()` checks.
